name: std-notify-on-event
description: std-notify-on-event — cross-orbital wiring atom. Subscribes to events from another orbital (e.g. CheckoutOrbital emits OrderPlaced, OrderRecordOrbital reacts via this atom) and dispatches a notification. Use when one orbital needs to react to or be notified about events that happen in another orbital — the wiring goes through this atom's `EventOccurred` listener which the molecule renames via traitOverrides.events to the upstream event name. Dispatch gates on `guardOp`: `eq` (default) does string-equality on `triggerStatus` against the upstream event's `status` field; `gt`/`lt`/`gte`/`lte` instead numerically compare `guardField` (read from the event's `data` payload) against `guardValue`, for threshold-crossing asks such as low-stock alerts. Resolves recipient from `recipients` (first entry; multi-recipient fan-out is a future extension), falling back to `fallbackRecipient` when set, or `@user.id` otherwise. Skips dispatch when the recipient is in `suppressionList`. Delivery consults std-notification-center data before dispatching: per-user NotificationPreference rows (matched on `userId` = recipient and `eventType` = this listener's `eventKey`, blank = all) can mute (`mode: off`), defer to the digest drain (`mode: digest`), override the channel, or impose per-user quiet hours; the atom-level `quietStartHour`/`quietEndHour` window and the `frequencyCapPerWeek` rolling cap (counted against dispatched NotificationRecord audit rows for the same recipient + channel) suppress likewise. Every suppression persists an honest audit row (`dispatched: false` with the reason in `error`: quiet-hours / digest-deferred / muted-by-preference / frequency-cap / no-push-subscription) which std-notification-center's digest cycle drains later. Channels: `in-app` emits the `notify` toast; `email`/`sms`/`webhook` dispatch through call-service (email.send / twilio.sendSMS / webhook.send); `push` looks up the recipient's PushSubscription row (owned by std-notification-center) and dispatches web-push via push.send (`pushTitle` falls back to `template`; `pushDeepLink`/`pushIcon` optional). The audit row's `dispatched` flag is honest — true only once the service call succeeds.

fields.name: recipient
fields.description: The identifier of the entity receiving the notification.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: The delivery method for the notification (e.g., email, SMS, in-app).

fields.name: message
fields.description: The content of the notification message.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Indicates the importance or urgency level of the notification.

fields.name: dispatched
fields.description: Indicates whether the notification has been successfully sent.

fields.name: error
fields.description: Failure detail from the delivery service when dispatched is false, or the suppression reason (quiet-hours / digest-deferred / muted-by-preference / frequency-cap / no-push-subscription).
fields.synonyms: error message, failure reason, dispatch error

fields.name: recordedAt
fields.description: Timestamp indicating when the notification record was created.

fields.name: prefMode
fields.description: Scratch: effective preference mode resolved for the current dispatch (instant/digest/off).

fields.name: prefChannel
fields.description: Scratch: channel override from the matched preference row; blank = no override.

fields.name: prefQuietStart
fields.description: Scratch: per-user quiet-hours start (hour 0-23) from the matched preference row.

fields.name: prefQuietEnd
fields.description: Scratch: per-user quiet-hours end (hour 0-23) from the matched preference row.

fields.name: pushEndpoint
fields.description: Scratch: push endpoint of the recipient's subscription for the current dispatch.

fields.name: pushP256dh

fields.name: pushAuth
fields.description: Scratch: auth secret of the recipient's push subscription.

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Owner of this preference row.

fields.name: eventType
fields.description: Event key this preference applies to (matches the listener's eventKey); blank = all events.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Delivery mode: instant, digest, or off.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Channel override for this user (in-app/email/sms/push/webhook); blank = the listener's configured channel.

fields.name: quietStartHour
fields.description: Per-user quiet-hours start (hour 0-23); equal to quietEndHour = disabled.
fields.synonyms: quiet start, do not disturb from

fields.name: quietEndHour
fields.description: Per-user quiet-hours end (hour 0-23); equal to quietStartHour = disabled.
fields.synonyms: quiet end, do not disturb until

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Owner of this browser push subscription.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: Push service endpoint URL for this subscription.

fields.name: p256dh
fields.description: Client public key (p256dh) of the subscription.

fields.name: auth
fields.description: Auth secret of the subscription.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When this subscription was captured.

eventKey.label: Event key for preferences
eventKey.description: Stable key naming the upstream event this listener is bound to (e.g. 'OrderPlaced'). NotificationPreference rows (std-notification-center) whose eventType equals this key — or is blank — apply to this listener's dispatches.
eventKey.synonyms: preference key, event name, subscription key, notification topic

webhookUrl.label: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Destination endpoint for the webhook channel. Dispatch only fires when this is non-blank; a blank URL on channel "webhook" records the audit row with dispatched:false instead of crashing (a consumer misconfiguration, not a failure).
webhookUrl.synonyms: webhook endpoint, callback url, target url, http endpoint, notify url

severity.label: Severity
severity.description: info, success, warning, or error — controls styling

pushIcon.label: Push icon
pushIcon.description: Icon URL shown on the push notification. Blank = the browser default.

guardValue.label: Guard value (numeric)
guardValue.description: Threshold compared against `guardField` when `guardOp` is not `eq` (e.g. fire when stock drops below 5).
guardValue.synonyms: threshold, cutoff, limit, watermark, trigger value

quietEndHour.label: Quiet hours end
quietEndHour.description: Hour of day (0-23) when the atom-level quiet window closes. Equal to `quietStartHour` = disabled.
quietEndHour.synonyms: do not disturb until, silence end, night mode end

suppressionList.label: Suppression list
suppressionList.description: Recipient ids/addresses to skip (e.g. unsubscribed users). Suppression check runs before dispatch.

webhookSecret.label: Webhook secret
webhookSecret.description: Signing secret forwarded to the webhook service so the receiving endpoint can verify the payload. Ignored when `webhookUrl` is blank.
webhookSecret.synonyms: signing secret, hmac secret, webhook signature, shared secret

frequencyCapPerWeek.label: Frequency cap (per week)
frequencyCapPerWeek.description: Max dispatched sends per (channel, recipient) per rolling 7-day window, counted against dispatched NotificationRecord audit rows. 0 = uncapped. Applies to the persisted channels (email/sms/push/webhook); in-app toasts are not audited and not capped. A capped dispatch persists an audit row (`error: frequency-cap`, dispatched:false).
frequencyCapPerWeek.synonyms: rate limit, cap, max per week, throttle, send limit

fallbackRecipient.label: Fallback recipient
fallbackRecipient.description: Recipient used when `recipients` is empty, instead of the acting user. The acting-user fallback (used when this is blank) is intended for personal notifications only — set this to an ops/team address (e.g. 'ops@example.com') for system alerts like low-stock or shipping notices, so the acting user isn't notified in place of the intended audience.
fallbackRecipient.synonyms: default recipient, backup recipient, ops address, fallback address, notify default, alert owner

guardOp.label: Guard comparison
guardOp.description: How to gate dispatch. `eq` (default) does string-equality via `triggerStatus` against the upstream event's `status` field, exactly as before. `gt`/`lt`/`gte`/`lte` instead numerically compare `guardField` (read from the event's `data` payload) against `guardValue` — e.g. fire only when a stock level drops below a threshold.
guardOp.synonyms: comparison operator, threshold operator, guard mode, trigger comparison, numeric gate, greater than, less than, threshold crossing

notifyChannel.label: Channel
notifyChannel.description: Delivery channel. `in-app` (default) emits the in-app `notify` toast. `email`/`sms`/`webhook` dispatch through call-service at event time (email.send / twilio.sendSMS / webhook.send) and persist a NotificationRecord audit row with an honest `dispatched` flag: true only once the service call succeeds, false plus the failure detail in `error` otherwise. `push` looks up the recipient's PushSubscription row (captured by std-notification-center's subscribe flow) and dispatches web-push via push.send — a recipient with no subscription records the audit row undispatched (`no-push-subscription`). `webhook` requires `webhookUrl` to actually dispatch; a blank `webhookUrl` still records the audit row undispatched rather than failing. A per-user NotificationPreference row with a non-blank `channel` overrides this value for that recipient.
notifyChannel.synonyms: delivery method, notification channel, send via, dispatch through, push notification, web push

guardField.label: Guard field (numeric)
guardField.description: Field read from the upstream event's `data` payload and compared against `guardValue` when `guardOp` is not `eq` (e.g. 'stockLevel', 'quantity'). Ignored when `guardOp` is `eq`.
guardField.synonyms: threshold field, numeric field, compare field, watched field, data field

quietStartHour.label: Quiet hours start
quietStartHour.description: Hour of day (0-23) when the atom-level quiet window opens. Equal to `quietEndHour` = disabled. Dispatches inside the window persist an audit row (`error: quiet-hours`, dispatched:false) which std-notification-center's digest cycle drains later. Per-user quiet hours from NotificationPreference rows apply in addition.
quietStartHour.synonyms: quiet hours, do not disturb from, silence start, night mode start

pushTitle.label: Push title
pushTitle.description: Notification title for the push channel. Falls back to `template` when blank. Ignored for other channels.
pushTitle.synonyms: notification title, push heading, alert title

recipients.label: Recipients
recipients.description: Recipient ids/addresses. v1.1 uses the first entry; multi-recipient fan-out lands in v1.2 (gap). When empty, falls back to `fallbackRecipient` if set, otherwise the authenticated user.

template.label: Message template
template.description: Text shown to the recipient; supports payload interpolation
template.synonyms: notification text, message body, alert text

triggerStatus.label: Trigger status
triggerStatus.description: When `guardOp` is `eq` and this is set, dispatch only when the upstream event's `status` field equals this value (e.g. fire only when a record becomes 'approved'). Empty = fire on every subscribed event. Ignored when `guardOp` is a numeric comparison.
triggerStatus.synonyms: on status, when status, status filter, only when, fire on, react on status

listensFor.label: Trigger events
listensFor.description: Event names that should fire a notification. Set this to the upstream event name (e.g. OrderPlaced, CheckoutCompleted) so this atom listens for events from the orbital that emits them. The orbital owning this trait reacts whenever the named event fires anywhere in the schema.
listensFor.synonyms: subscribe to event, listen for event, react to event, watch for, wire upstream event, observe event from another orbital, cross-orbital subscription, on-event trigger

emailSubject.label: Email subject
emailSubject.description: Subject line used for the email channel. Falls back to `template` when blank. Ignored for other channels.
emailSubject.synonyms: subject, subject line, email title, mail subject

pushDeepLink.label: Push deep link
pushDeepLink.description: In-app path opened when the recipient clicks the push notification (e.g. '/orders'). Blank = the app root.
pushDeepLink.synonyms: click url, open on click, target path, notification link

          recordedAt: @now
          severity: @entity.severity
        }) (if ["=", @entity.channel, in-app] (do (set @entity.dispatched true) (notify @config.severity @config.template)) (fetch NotificationRecord {
          emit: { failure: NOTIFY_LOOKUP_FAILED, success: NOTIFY_CAP_LOADED }
          filter: [">", (object/get @entity recordedAt), ["-", @now, 604800000]]
        })))))
      NOTIFY_CAP_LOADED -> idle
        (if (and [">", @config.frequencyCapPerWeek, 0] [">=", (array/len (array/filter ?data (fn r (and ["=", (object/get @r recipient), @entity.recipient] ["=", (object/get @r channel), @entity.channel] ["=", (object/get @r dispatched), true])))), @config.frequencyCapPerWeek]) (persist create NotificationRecord {
          channel: @entity.channel
          dispatched: false
          error: "frequency-cap"
          message: @entity.message
          recipient: @entity.recipient
          recordedAt: @now
          severity: @entity.severity
        }) (if ["=", @entity.channel, email] (call-service "email" "send" {
          body: @entity.message
          from: ""
          subject: (if ["=", @config.emailSubject, ""] @entity.message @config.emailSubject)
          to: @entity.recipient
        } { emit: { failure: NOTIFY_EMAIL_FAILED, success: NOTIFY_EMAIL_SENT } }) (if ["=", @entity.channel, sms] (call-service "twilio" "sendSMS" {
          body: @entity.message
          to: @entity.recipient
        } { emit: { failure: NOTIFY_SMS_FAILED, success: NOTIFY_SMS_SENT } }) (if ["=", @entity.channel, push] (fetch PushSubscription { emit: { failure: NOTIFY_LOOKUP_FAILED, success: NOTIFY_PUSH_SUBS } }) (if (not ["=", @config.webhookUrl, ""]) (call-service "webhook" "send" {
          event: @entity.message
          payload: { message: @entity.message, recipient: @entity.recipient, severity: @entity.severity }
          secret: @config.webhookSecret
          url: @config.webhookUrl
        } { emit: { failure: NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_FAILED, success: NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SENT } }) (persist create NotificationRecord {
          channel: @entity.channel
          dispatched: false
          message: @entity.message
          recipient: @entity.recipient
          recordedAt: @now
          severity: @entity.severity
        }))))))
      NOTIFY_PUSH_SUBS -> idle
        (set @entity.pushEndpoint (if ["=", (array/len (array/filter ?data (fn s ["=", (object/get @s userId), @entity.recipient]))), 0] "" (object/get (array/first (array/filter ?data (fn s ["=", (object/get @s userId), @entity.recipient]))) endpoint)))
        (set @entity.pushP256dh (if ["=", (array/len (array/filter ?data (fn s ["=", (object/get @s userId), @entity.recipient]))), 0] "" (object/get (array/first (array/filter ?data (fn s ["=", (object/get @s userId), @entity.recipient]))) p256dh)))
        (set @entity.pushAuth (if ["=", (array/len (array/filter ?data (fn s ["=", (object/get @s userId), @entity.recipient]))), 0] "" (object/get (array/first (array/filter ?data (fn s ["=", (object/get @s userId), @entity.recipient]))) auth)))
        (if ["=", @entity.pushEndpoint, ""] (persist create NotificationRecord {
          channel: @entity.channel
          dispatched: false
          error: "no-push-subscription"
          message: @entity.message
          recipient: @entity.recipient
          recordedAt: @now
          severity: @entity.severity
        }) (call-service "push" "send" {
          subscription: { endpoint: @entity.pushEndpoint, keys: { auth: @entity.pushAuth, p256dh: @entity.pushP256dh } }
          title: (if ["=", @config.pushTitle, ""] @entity.message @config.pushTitle)
          body: @entity.message
          url: @config.pushDeepLink
          icon: @config.pushIcon
        } { emit: { failure: NOTIFY_PUSH_FAILED, success: NOTIFY_PUSH_SENT } }))
      NOTIFY_EMAIL_SENT -> idle
        (set @entity.dispatched true)
        (persist create NotificationRecord {
          channel: @entity.channel
          dispatched: true
          message: @entity.message
          recipient: @entity.recipient
          recordedAt: @now
          severity: @entity.severity
        })
      NOTIFY_EMAIL_FAILED -> idle
        (set @entity.dispatched false)
        (set @entity.error ?error)
        (persist create NotificationRecord {
          channel: @entity.channel
          dispatched: false
          error: @entity.error
          message: @entity.message
          recipient: @entity.recipient
          recordedAt: @now
          severity: @entity.severity
        })
      NOTIFY_SMS_SENT -> idle
        (set @entity.dispatched true)
        (persist create NotificationRecord {
          channel: @entity.channel
          dispatched: true
          message: @entity.message
          recipient: @entity.recipient
          recordedAt: @now
          severity: @entity.severity
        })
      NOTIFY_SMS_FAILED -> idle
        (set @entity.dispatched false)
        (set @entity.error ?error)
        (persist create NotificationRecord {
          channel: @entity.channel
          dispatched: false
          error: @entity.error
          message: @entity.message
          recipient: @entity.recipient
          recordedAt: @now
          severity: @entity.severity
        })
      NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SENT -> idle
        (set @entity.dispatched true)
        (persist create NotificationRecord {
          channel: @entity.channel
          dispatched: true
          message: @entity.message
          recipient: @entity.recipient
          recordedAt: @now
          severity: @entity.severity
        })
      NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_FAILED -> idle
        (set @entity.dispatched false)
        (set @entity.error ?error)
        (persist create NotificationRecord {
          channel: @entity.channel
          dispatched: false
          error: @entity.error
          message: @entity.message
          recipient: @entity.recipient
          recordedAt: @now
          severity: @entity.severity
        })
      NOTIFY_PUSH_SENT -> idle
        (set @entity.dispatched true)
        (persist create NotificationRecord {
          channel: @entity.channel
          dispatched: true
          message: @entity.message
          recipient: @entity.recipient
          recordedAt: @now
          severity: @entity.severity
        })
      NOTIFY_PUSH_FAILED -> idle
        (set @entity.dispatched false)
        (set @entity.error ?error)
        (persist create NotificationRecord {
          channel: @entity.channel
          dispatched: false
          error: @entity.error
          message: @entity.message
          recipient: @entity.recipient
          recordedAt: @now
          severity: @entity.severity
        })
      NOTIFY_LOOKUP_FAILED -> idle
        (set @entity.dispatched false)
        (set @entity.error ?error)
        (persist create NotificationRecord {
          channel: @entity.channel
          dispatched: false
          error: @entity.error
          message: @entity.message
          recipient: @entity.recipient
          recordedAt: @now
          severity: @entity.severity
        })
    }

    emits {
      NotificationDispatched -> external {
        recipient : string
        channel : string
        message : string
        severity : string
      }
      NOTIFY_PREFS_LOADED {
        data : [PrefRow]
      }
        @description "NotificationPreference rows loaded; the arm resolves the recipient's effective mode/channel/quiet-hours"
        @tier "secondary"
      NOTIFY_CAP_LOADED {
        data : [AuditRow]
      }
        @description "Rolling 7-day NotificationRecord window loaded; the arm enforces frequencyCapPerWeek then dispatches"
        @tier "secondary"
      NOTIFY_PUSH_SUBS {
        data : [SubRow]
      }
        @description "PushSubscription rows loaded; the arm picks the recipient's subscription and dispatches push.send"
        @tier "secondary"
      NOTIFY_EMAIL_SENT {
        id : string!
        status : string!
      }
        @description "email.send service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor"
        @tier "secondary"
      NOTIFY_EMAIL_FAILED {
        error : string!
      }
        @description "email.send service call failed — dispatched lands false and error carries the service detail"
        @tier "secondary"
      NOTIFY_SMS_SENT {
        sid : string!
        status : string!
      }
        @description "twilio.sendSMS service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor"
        @tier "secondary"
      NOTIFY_SMS_FAILED {
        error : string!
      }
        @description "twilio.sendSMS service call failed — dispatched lands false and error carries the service detail"
        @tier "secondary"
      NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SENT {
        status : number!
        ok : boolean!
        durationMs : number!
      }
        @description "webhook.send service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor"
        @tier "secondary"
      NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_FAILED {
        error : string!
      }
        @description "webhook.send service call failed — dispatched lands false and error carries the service detail"
        @tier "secondary"
      NOTIFY_PUSH_SENT {
        statusCode : number!
        ok : boolean!
        expired : boolean!
      }
        @description "push.send service result — expired:true means the subscription is gone and should be pruned"
        @tier "secondary"
      NOTIFY_PUSH_FAILED {
        error : string!
      }
        @description "push.send service call failed — dispatched lands false and error carries the service detail"
        @tier "secondary"
      NOTIFY_LOOKUP_FAILED {
        error : string!
      }
        @description "A preference / cap-window / subscription fetch failed — dispatched lands false with the fetch error"
        @tier "secondary"
    }

    listens {
      EventOccurred {
        data : object
        status : string
      }
      NOTIFY_PREFS_LOADED {
        data : [PrefRow]
      }
      NOTIFY_CAP_LOADED {
        data : [AuditRow]
      }
      NOTIFY_PUSH_SUBS {
        data : [SubRow]
      }
    }

    config {
      triggerStatus : string = ""
        @label "Trigger status"
        @description "When `guardOp` is `eq` and this is set, dispatch only when the upstream event's `status` field equals this value (e.g. fire only when a record becomes 'approved'). Empty = fire on every subscribed event. Ignored when `guardOp` is a numeric comparison."
        @synonyms "on status, when status, status filter, only when, fire on, react on status"
        @tier "policy"
      guardOp : "eq" | "gt" | "lt" | "gte" | "lte" = eq
        @label "Guard comparison"
        @description "How to gate dispatch. `eq` (default) does string-equality via `triggerStatus` against the upstream event's `status` field, exactly as before. `gt`/`lt`/`gte`/`lte` instead numerically compare `guardField` (read from the event's `data` payload) against `guardValue` — e.g. fire only when a stock level drops below a threshold."
        @synonyms "comparison operator, threshold operator, guard mode, trigger comparison, numeric gate, greater than, less than, threshold crossing"
        @tier "policy"
      guardField : string = ""
        @label "Guard field (numeric)"
        @description "Field read from the upstream event's `data` payload and compared against `guardValue` when `guardOp` is not `eq` (e.g. 'stockLevel', 'quantity'). Ignored when `guardOp` is `eq`."
        @synonyms "threshold field, numeric field, compare field, watched field, data field"
        @tier "policy"
      guardValue : number = 0
        @label "Guard value (numeric)"
        @description "Threshold compared against `guardField` when `guardOp` is not `eq` (e.g. fire when stock drops below 5)."
        @synonyms "threshold, cutoff, limit, watermark, trigger value"
        @tier "policy"
      listensFor : [string] = []
        @label "Trigger events"
        @description "Event names that should fire a notification. Set this to the upstream event name (e.g. OrderPlaced, CheckoutCompleted) so this atom listens for events from the orbital that emits them. The orbital owning this trait reacts whenever the named event fires anywhere in the schema."
        @synonyms "subscribe to event, listen for event, react to event, watch for, wire upstream event, observe event from another orbital, cross-orbital subscription, on-event trigger"
        @tier "internal"
      eventKey : string = ""
        @label "Event key for preferences"
        @description "Stable key naming the upstream event this listener is bound to (e.g. 'OrderPlaced'). NotificationPreference rows (std-notification-center) whose eventType equals this key — or is blank — apply to this listener's dispatches."
        @synonyms "preference key, event name, subscription key, notification topic"
        @tier "policy"
      notifyChannel : "in-app" | "email" | "sms" | "push" | "webhook" = in-app
        @label "Channel"
        @description "Delivery channel. `in-app` (default) emits the in-app `notify` toast. `email`/`sms`/`webhook` dispatch through call-service at event time (email.send / twilio.sendSMS / webhook.send) and persist a NotificationRecord audit row with an honest `dispatched` flag: true only once the service call succeeds, false plus the failure detail in `error` otherwise. `push` looks up the recipient's PushSubscription row (captured by std-notification-center's subscribe flow) and dispatches web-push via push.send — a recipient with no subscription records the audit row undispatched (`no-push-subscription`). `webhook` requires `webhookUrl` to actually dispatch; a blank `webhookUrl` still records the audit row undispatched rather than failing. A per-user NotificationPreference row with a non-blank `channel` overrides this value for that recipient."
        @synonyms "delivery method, notification channel, send via, dispatch through, push notification, web push"
        @tier "policy"
      emailSubject : string = ""
        @label "Email subject"
        @description "Subject line used for the email channel. Falls back to `template` when blank. Ignored for other channels."
        @synonyms "subject, subject line, email title, mail subject"
        @tier "presentation"
      pushTitle : string = ""
        @label "Push title"
        @description "Notification title for the push channel. Falls back to `template` when blank. Ignored for other channels."
        @synonyms "notification title, push heading, alert title"
        @tier "presentation"
      pushDeepLink : string = ""
        @label "Push deep link"
        @description "In-app path opened when the recipient clicks the push notification (e.g. '/orders'). Blank = the app root."
        @synonyms "click url, open on click, target path, notification link"
        @tier "presentation"
      pushIcon : string = ""
        @label "Push icon"
        @description "Icon URL shown on the push notification. Blank = the browser default."
        @synonyms "notification icon, badge image"
        @tier "presentation"
      webhookUrl : string = ""
        @label "Webhook URL"
        @description "Destination endpoint for the webhook channel. Dispatch only fires when this is non-blank; a blank URL on channel \"webhook\" records the audit row with dispatched:false instead of crashing (a consumer misconfiguration, not a failure)."
        @synonyms "webhook endpoint, callback url, target url, http endpoint, notify url"
        @tier "policy"
      webhookSecret : string = ""
        @label "Webhook secret"
        @description "Signing secret forwarded to the webhook service so the receiving endpoint can verify the payload. Ignored when `webhookUrl` is blank."
        @synonyms "signing secret, hmac secret, webhook signature, shared secret"
        @tier "internal"
      template : string = ""
        @label "Message template"
        @description "Text shown to the recipient; supports payload interpolation"
        @synonyms "notification text, message body, alert text"
        @tier "presentation"
      severity : string = info
        @label "Severity"
        @description "info, success, warning, or error — controls styling"
        @synonyms "alert level, priority, urgency"
        @tier "policy"
      recipients : [string] = []
        @label "Recipients"
        @description "Recipient ids/addresses. v1.1 uses the first entry; multi-recipient fan-out lands in v1.2 (gap). When empty, falls back to `fallbackRecipient` if set, otherwise the authenticated user."
        @synonyms "targets, addressees, notify to"
        @tier "policy"
      fallbackRecipient : string = ""
        @label "Fallback recipient"
        @description "Recipient used when `recipients` is empty, instead of the acting user. The acting-user fallback (used when this is blank) is intended for personal notifications only — set this to an ops/team address (e.g. 'ops@example.com') for system alerts like low-stock or shipping notices, so the acting user isn't notified in place of the intended audience."
        @synonyms "default recipient, backup recipient, ops address, fallback address, notify default, alert owner"
        @tier "policy"
      suppressionList : [string] = []
        @label "Suppression list"
        @description "Recipient ids/addresses to skip (e.g. unsubscribed users). Suppression check runs before dispatch."
        @synonyms "block list, unsubscribed, opt-out list"
        @tier "policy"
      quietStartHour : number = 0
        @label "Quiet hours start"
        @description "Hour of day (0-23) when the atom-level quiet window opens. Equal to `quietEndHour` = disabled. Dispatches inside the window persist an audit row (`error: quiet-hours`, dispatched:false) which std-notification-center's digest cycle drains later. Per-user quiet hours from NotificationPreference rows apply in addition."
        @synonyms "quiet hours, do not disturb from, silence start, night mode start"
        @tier "policy"
      quietEndHour : number = 0
        @label "Quiet hours end"
        @description "Hour of day (0-23) when the atom-level quiet window closes. Equal to `quietStartHour` = disabled."
        @synonyms "do not disturb until, silence end, night mode end"
        @tier "policy"
      frequencyCapPerWeek : number = 0
        @label "Frequency cap (per week)"
        @description "Max dispatched sends per (channel, recipient) per rolling 7-day window, counted against dispatched NotificationRecord audit rows. 0 = uncapped. Applies to the persisted channels (email/sms/push/webhook); in-app toasts are not audited and not capped. A capped dispatch persists an audit row (`error: frequency-cap`, dispatched:false)."
        @synonyms "rate limit, cap, max per week, throttle, send limit"
        @tier "policy"
    }
  }

  page "/notify-on-event" as NotifyOnEventPage -> NotifyOnEventListener
}
